g.text: Workflow 4: Comprehensive Audit Finalization, Canvas PDF & WhatsApp Dispatch
Complete physical item counts across shift
Click "Finish & Archive Audit / إنهاء واعتماد الجرد"
"يوجد أصناف لم يتم جردها، هل تريد اعتبارها صفراً أم تخطيها؟"
Review shrinkage items and high-variance alerts
Click "Commit Final Audit / اعتماد الترحيل النهائي"
Enter PIN via secure numeric keypad
Navigate to Audit History or click "Generate PDF Report"
Display confirmation: "تم تصدير وحفظ التقرير بنجاح"
Set physical count = 0 for remaining items
Uncounted items exist in current shift catalog?
Compare entered PIN hash against stored role PIN
Archive final balances as starting stock for next shift
Draw store branding, title header, date, and shift
Render structured RTL Arabic inventory table:
(Item, Base Unit, Expected, Actual, Variance, Status)
Convert Canvas pages to vector document via jsPDF
Launch WhatsApp Web or mobile app via deep-link
